claims.text: Standard classification algorithms trained on biased datasets can produce discriminatory classifiers even when sensitive attributes are removed from training data.
A non-discrimination constraint can be incorporated into decision tree learning by modifying the splitting criterion.
A non-discrimination constraint can be incorporated into decision tree learning by modifying the pruning strategy.

evidence.description: Using the standard learners on this data may lead to wrongfully biased classifiers, even if the attribute B is removed from training data.
In this paper we study an alternative approach in which the non-discrimination constraint is pushed deeply into a decision tree learner by changing its splitting criterion
In this paper we study an alternative approach in which the non-discrimination constraint is pushed deeply into a decision tree learner by changing its... pruning strategy.

methodologies.name: Discrimination Aware Decision Tree Learning
methodologies.description: Modifies the splitting criterion and pruning strategy of a decision tree algorithm to directly enforce a non-discrimination constraint during model training.

limitations.text: Existing solutions consist of cleaning away discrimination from datasets before a classifier is learned.
